claims.text: Automations like missed-call text-back, review engine, and win-backs install once and run continuously without manual upkeep
Setup takes minutes with no onboarding calls or certification courses required
Manual, one-attempt follow-up is the real time sink for most service teams
Increasing ad spend without fixing follow-up increases lost leads and cost per sale rather than revenue
Advertising creates opportunities; systems convert them into revenue (Black Arrow's core positioning)
